sports.headline: Alcaraz beats world No. 1 Zverev to win his first ATP Finals title
sports.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7) in the Turin final on Sunday, saving three set points in the tie-break. He becomes the fourth man to win all four Grand Slams and the ATP Finals, after Agassi, Federer and Djokovic. It is his sixth title of 2026 and he finishes the year on a 14-match winning run.

sports.headline: Kansas City Current win first NWSL Championship, beating Washington Spirit 2-1
sports.summary: The Current won their first NWSL title on Saturday at Audi Field, with goals from Vanessa DiBernardo (also the MVP) and Debinha. Trinity Rodman pulled one back late for the Spirit, who lost a third straight final. Kansas City got there under first-year coach Chris Armas.

sports.headline: Verstappen wins Las Vegas GP from Norris and Piastri after a 35-lead-change race
sports.summary: Max Verstappen took his third Las Vegas win in four years, holding off Lando Norris by 0.639s and Oscar Piastri finishing third. Both Mercedes cars fell back late in the race. The title was already decided, with Kimi Antonelli champion. Verstappen's fourth win in six races has put him second in the standings.
